evidence_history: Study-level published directional findings and treatment labels are public and already known. No experiment CSV row-level response values have been read in this target protocol. A held-out test within the published dataset is a retrospective independent-site validation, not a genuinely prospective independent ecological intervention study.
parent: EOG PR #704 source-only gate; EOG PR #702 exploratory synthetic BAM span audit; neither is modified.

source.mirror: Zenodo record 5023851 is not accepted until byte equivalence for both files and source attribution are verified.
source.credit: Hodapp D., Borer E.T., Harpole W.S. et al. (2019) Dataset doi:10.5061/dryad.8vs569h

target.name: site-level difference-in-differences of spatial community-state upper-span after herbivore exclusion
target.unit: independent experimental site (site_code); matched treatment blocks not independent sites
target.features: For each site, create one complete taxon identity axis using only its observed taxon IDs across candidate plot-years, with absent taxa 0 only when complete vegetation census is documented. For every plot×year, Hellinger-transform percent cover: sqrt(cover/sum_cover). If true total cover is 0 and sample is certified, use the zero vector; exclude no sample silently.
target.span: 90th percentile of strictly positive Euclidean pairwise distances among Hellinger plot composition vectors, return 0 if no strictly positive pairs; equal plot/arm/year matched blocks throughout. No separate treatment-specific scaling.
target.secondary: Site-block matched Jaccard turnover Y0→Y3: median block[(Jaccard_Fence)-(Jaccard_Control)]; report separately and never substitute as primary
non_goals: Do not call this environmental niche span
Do not call Fence a deletion of all biotic B constraints
Do not call NPK a deletion of all abiotic A constraints

eligibility.duplicate_sample_or_conflicting_coverage: SCIENTIFIC_STOP; do not sum, average, or silently drop
eligibility.missing_year0_or_year3: SCIENTIFIC_STOP at affected site, retain flow record
eligibility.cover_type: numeric finite percent cover >=0; values >100 need documented original meaning or STOP
eligibility.group_rule: blocks matched by site_code and block; plots by site_code,block,plot; one arm sample per block
eligibility.holdout_rule: Sort eligible site_code by SHA256(utf8('EOG_NUTNET_Y3_20261119_V1|'+site_code)); first ceil(0.25*n) are held out, remainder train; group site wholly across blocks and years
eligibility.source_access_stop: Any archive MD5, size, raw download, licence or file-identity mismatch blocks scoring

predictors.time_cutoff: Y0 only; no Y1-Y3 information or site-level responses in predictor construction
biotic: Y0 mean plot richness over matched plots
Y0 mean Jaccard dissimilarity among matched plots
predictors.abiotic: All numeric non-ID/non-treatment covariates in env-param-Y0 with provenance explicitly labelled PRETREATMENT, summarized to site medians. No post-treatment covariates.
predictors.standardization: Training-site means/standard deviations only; missing-value imputation by training-site medians with missing indicators; no holdout-derived scale or variable selection.

model_universe.penalty: Fixed ridge alpha=10; non-intercept predictors standardized on train only; no model tuning based on holdout
model_universe.prediction: For each heldout site, compute D_hat under each of the four models; issue signed prediction only if every model strictly >+0.02 or every model strictly <-0.02. Otherwise abstain.
model_universe.restrictions: Candidate predictive representations are not independently established causal BAM mechanisms; agreement across models is conditional on this limited predeclared family.
model_universe.uncertainty_sensitivity: Optional predetermined 200 site-level bootstrap repetitions of train sites per model, deterministic seed 20261119; report 5th and 95th percentiles but never use them to change primary decision
model_universe.baseline: Training intercept-only mean sign at the same 0.02 tolerance (without unanimity). Also evaluate majority nonzero sign as descriptive comparator.

endpoints: wrong-sign count over all signed holdout sites (including true zero as wrong)
never_report_as: proof of predicting true ecological mechanism
new independent replication of published treatment effect
evaluation.prospective_after_score: No result-specific changes to target, unit, universe or threshold. Any amendment needs a new protocol and prominent post-exposure flag.

workflow: if all gates pass, run predeclared site split and full training/holdout score
archive raw provenance, all positive and negative findings, failures
analysis_source_access_at_creation: No original individual treatment response entries opened.
